idea: One-to-one AI coaching for senior partners
buyer: Partners and MDs who are privately behind on AI
pain: Senior people cannot admit in public that they do not know how to use these tools
channel: Her network plus husband's banking contacts
verdict: Genuine unmet need and easy to sell privately, but one-to-one coaching has the worst leverage available.

why.distribution: 50+ senior people across both networks, and the sale is a quiet private conversation.
why.demand: The embarrassment is real and senior people pay to solve it discreetly.
why.fmf: Changing how sceptical senior professionals work is precisely her distinctive experience.
why.revenue_structure: One-off programmes; no natural renewal once someone is competent.
why.leverage: Pure billable hours, one person at a time - the lowest leverage shape possible.
why.tailwind: The anxiety is at its peak right now.
why.ceiling: £4k x 30 people = £120k, and thirty individual programmes is a full calendar.

ceiling_arithmetic: £4k x 30 people = £120k, requiring thirty individual coaching programmes - roughly 120 contact hours plus preparation. Realistic part-time: 10-12 = £40-48k.
carries: A genuinely unmet and slightly embarrassing need, sold privately to people who can pay personally.
kills: Leverage at 1 and no repeat. Once someone is competent, the relationship ends.
test: Offer a four-session programme at £3.5k to three senior contacts.
test_fail: They say they will just ask a junior.
